properties.displayName: AKS clusters must have private nodes, an OIDC issuer and no local accounts
properties.description: Denies AKS clusters that violate any of three baseline controls: (1) an agent pool that assigns public IPs to its nodes, which puts the kubelet and every hostNetwork pod directly on the internet behind nothing but an NSG; (2) a disabled OIDC issuer, without which Entra ID Workload Identity federation cannot function and workloads fall back to sharing the kubelet identity; (3) enabled local admin accounts, whose client certificate bypasses Entra ID entirely - no MFA, no conditional access, no per-user audit trail, and no revocation short of rotating the cluster CA. The three clauses are combined with anyOf so a cluster failing any one of them is non-compliant. This definition is the platform-side mirror of conftest rules 2, 3 and 9 in policy/conftest/terraform.rego: the conftest rules fail the pull request, this one stops the same change arriving through the portal, the CLI, or a pipeline outside this repository.

metadata.description: Deny blocks non-compliant cluster create/update calls. Audit records the compliance state only; use it to measure an existing estate before enforcing.
When true, a cluster with oidcIssuerProfile.enabled set to false (or absent) is non-compliant. Workload Identity federation is built on this issuer.

metadata.displayName: Require local accounts to be disabled
metadata.description: When true, a cluster with disableLocalAccounts set to false (or absent) is non-compliant. Set to false only for a sandbox management group, and record the justification in the assignment metadata.
